correctness.rationale: Over k algebraically closed, char3, A=a+b!=0, B=b-a!=0, D=(ab)^2-(a+b)^3=0: exact cubic coordinate identity, primitive-linear irreducibility, and gradient give the unique ordinary cusp P. At each axis f(q)=q^3+a q^2+b q+1 has a double root q=b/a and one simple root, with nonzero transverse derivative A^3/a^2. Pullback via the squaring map produces precisely six ordinary axis nodes and four etale cusp preimages. Independent odd-parity coordinate valuations prove degree-four connected Kummer extension and tame Riemann-Hurwitz gives genus zero; plane genus defect 10 verifies count. The packaged symbolic verifier passed the critical identities and nonempty boundary witness. No finite experiment substitutes for the all-field proof.

value.rationale: The discriminant D=0 is the canonical collision locus for coordinate-axis cubic sections of the published generalized Wiman-Edge sextic; it is nonempty and defines a natural codimension-one boundary. The exact new six-node structure, four persistent cusps, connected-cover normalization and genus collapse from six to zero together determine a complete motivated geometric degeneration. This is more than a routine recomputation of a generic genus formula or an arbitrary finite slice. The geometric boundary excludes a=b, a+b=0 and makes no unsupported arithmetic applications.
